android.desc:
Your phone should adapt to your life, not compete for your attention.

At the gym, social media disappears. During work hours, only useful apps stay visible. At night, your phone becomes a quieter place.

There’s no timer to start and no focus mode to remember. Haven adapts automatically based on where you are and what time it is.

Haven is a privacy-first minimalist launcher for Android. It replaces the traditional icon grid with a calm text-based app list, automatically filters distracting apps, and adds intentional friction when temptation strikes.

AUTOMATIC FOCUS BY TIME OR PLACE

Create Focus Havens that change which apps appear on your phone:

• Location Havens automatically activate at places like the office, library, gym, or school.
• Time Havens help protect work sessions, study blocks, evenings, and sleep.

Set them once and Haven runs quietly in the background.

A CALMER HOME SCREEN

No app icons. No notification dots. No colorful grid competing for your attention.

Your apps are presented as a simple list of names, making it easier to find what you need without being pulled into something else.

A PAUSE BEFORE DISTRACTION

Filtered apps aren’t permanently locked. You can still open one when you truly need it—but doing so requires 100 deliberate taps.

That pause interrupts impulsive behavior and gives you time to reconsider before opening a distracting app.

MAKE IT YOURS

Personalize your home screen with wallpapers and widgets while keeping the experience calm and intentional.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your location and usage data stay on your device. They are never sent to us.

TURN YOUR PHONE BACK INTO A TOOL

Haven is designed for students, professionals, digital minimalists, and anyone who wants to spend less time opening apps without thinking.

No ads.

quotes.text: I wanted a minimalist launcher that limits the apps I can access based on my location. I waste way to much time doom scrolling at home, and simply removing the app from my apps list based on my location has really helped.
